Name: Pelipper Town
Author: AlexanderVerde
Description:
Pelipper Town brings Pokemon into the everyday life of Stardew Valley! Now in Vietnamese due to the work of  zConnorI22 and VotriValley!
Explore the valley with Pokemon by your side, find them in different habitats, let suitable partners help around the farm, and experience some new quests involving Pokémon and familiar townspeople.
The mod can be played solo or in multiplayer and works with new or existing saves. While I recommend starting a new save to get the proper Pelipper Town experience, I understand if you would rather stick to your exquisitely planned year 5 farm that has hit perfection and gives you 3,000,000.00 dollars a day and where you have maxed out hearts with every npc. Therefore Pelipper Town also will work fine with pre-existing saves.

[center][b][color=#fafafa][size=4]What you can do[/size][/color][/b][/center]

[list]
[*]Find Pokemon throughout the valley and its surrounding areas[/*]
[*]Keep a party and travel with an active partner[/*]
[*]Let suitable Pokemon help with crops, animals, foraging, fishing, mining, orchards, crab pots, and other farm work[/*]
[*]Train Pokemon, choose moves, build bonds, and evolve them[/*]
[*]Take part in battles and new quests involving villagers and their Pokémon (and maybe some legendary pokemon as well!)[/*]
[*]Breed compatible Pokémon in a Barn[/*]
[*]Play with separate parties and progression for each farmer in multiplayer[/*]
[*]Adjust encounters, chores, combat, controls, accessibility options, and other parts of the experience[/*]
[/list][heading][center][b]Multiplayer[/b][/center]
[/heading]
Pelipper Town is playable in multiplayer!
Each farmer has their own starting journey, party, active partner, progression, and personal Pokémon storage. The host manages shared wild encounters and world activity, while farmhands can still catch, command, train, battle, breed, trade, and manage their own Pokémon. I have done limited testing with three players at a time, and would be happy to hear about the experience with more than that!
[heading][center][b]Getting started[/b][/center]
[/heading]
After loading a new or existing save, a pop up appears that lets you choose your starters. Afterwards, leave the farmhouse and meet Marnie. She will help you choose how you want to begin.
Press P to open the Partner Journal. This is the main place to manage your party, choose moves and work policies, check progression, and look for Pokémon.
The default keyboard controls are:
[list]
[*]P: Open the Partner Journal[/*]
[*]O: Send out, swap, or recall the selected Pokémon[/*]
[*][ and ]: Select a party member[/*]
[*]Hold G, then release: Aim and throw a Pokeball (or you treat it like a fishing rod and throw the same way you cast!)[/*]
[*]B inside a Barn: Open the Barn Pokémon menu[/*]
[*]F5: Enable or disable the companion system[/*]
[/list]Controller controls are included. By default, R3 selects the next party member, tapping L3 sends or recalls it, holding L3 opens the Partner Journal, holding the left trigger aims a throw, and RB opens the Pokémon Barn menu while inside a Barn.
All bindings can be changed through Generic Mod Config Menu.
[heading][center][b]Requirements[/b][/center]
[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] 4.0 or later[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url] 1.28.4 or later[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] 1.16 or later, optional but recommended[/*]
[/list][heading][center][b]Recommended settings mod[/b][/center]
[/heading]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is optional but strongly recommended.
It gives you an in-game menu where you can shape Pelipper Town around the experience you want. You can adjust encounter pacing, capture assistance, combat, companion health, farm chores, controls, villager partners, accessibility options, and more.
The mod can still be configured without it by editing config.json.
[heading][center][b]Installation[/b][/center]
[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI and SpaceCore.[/*]
[*]Download the Pelipper Town release.[/*]
[*]Extract the PelipperTown.Mod folder into Stardew Valley’s Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][heading][center][b]Optional compatibility[/b][/center]
[/heading]
Stardew Valley Expanded, East Scarp, and Ridgeside Village are completely optional.
Pelipper Town can add regional encounters and villager partners when these expansions are installed. Separate integration packs are available for players who prefer to keep that compatibility as its own installation.
[heading][center][b]Artwork and credits[/b][/center]
[/heading]
Pokémon sprites and portraits are primarily adapted from the[url=https://github.com/PMDCollab/SpriteCollab] PMDCollab SpriteCollab[/url] archive. The packaged credit indexes retain the available source and contributor histories for the selected artwork.
Item and interface artwork also uses material from[url=https://github.com/rh-hideout/pokeemerald-expansion] pokeemerald-expansion[/url]. Some visual effects are adapted from Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky, and a small amount of artwork is derived from Stardew Valley assets.
Full source links, individual contributor records, licenses, and redistribution notes are included in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
[heading][center]Compatibility notice[/center]
[/heading]
Pelipper Town is not compatible with Pokémon Battle Companions. Both mods add their own Pokémon companion and battle systems, so running them together may cause conflicts or unexpected behavior. Please use only one of these mods at a time.
